name: Cobalt Blue Mountain Bicycle
prompt: Make a real editable Blender 3D model of ONE realistic mountain bicycle in side profile, not a motorcycle, not a chair. The bike's main steel/aluminum frame is bold vivid cobalt BLUE (#1465D7) with a triangular top tube, down tube and seat tube. EXACTLY TWO very large separated BLACK mountain-bike rubber wheels with broad, fat knobby off-road tires, one at the LEFT and one at the RIGHT of the frame. Wheels are vertical, parallel in one plane and have black metal rims, hubs and visible spokes. Bicycle features an angled front suspension fork, flat black handlebar with handgrips, long black saddle on seat post, central pedal crank and two pedals, small chainring and rear gear. Natural bicycle shape and proportions, two wheel centers aligned and the bike supported by its wheels on the ground. Strongly prioritize the two prominent thick knobby tires and blue triangular frame. Real 3D geometry and realistic dark rubber and glossy blue metal materials. Render a side three-quarter view of the whole bicycle.
